name: RZE Zero-Word Bitmap Reducer
description: GPU port of the LC framework RZE component. Processes word_size-byte words independently per chunk, compacts non-zero words, emits a 1-bit-per-word bitmap, and recursively compresses that bitmap through 2048/256/32/4-byte levels. Lossless. Forward is CUDA Graph-capturable; inverse requires blocking D2H header reads. RZE is retained as the upstream identifier without assigning it an expansion.

config.name: wordSize
config.description: Word granularity in bytes (LC RZE_N). Typically 4 after BitshuffleStage(elementWidth=4).

config.name: chunkSize
config.description: Chunk size in bytes. Only 16384 is currently supported.
